subject: Clarify EU listing footnote: 24x7 support claim + localized branding strings
messages:
From: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify EU listing footnote for 24x7 support & localized branding

Hi Kimberly / Vanessa,

We're doing the final preflight for the Acme Analytics AWS listing and ran into two EU-specific items that need clarification before we can publish: 1) the use of a "24x7 support" claim in the marketing copy (AWS requires a regional footnote for EU-located customers if support is routed outside the EEA), and 2) translated brand strings for German/French/Spanish assets where local trademark punctuation differs.

Attached is the "AWS listing review ask" with the exact text snippets we pulled. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood/Acme will accept a footnote that reads: "Support availability may vary by region; refer to support hours in product listing" or whether you prefer more prescriptive language (AWS requires explicit routing/response-time info in some territories).
- Who will provide localized (DE/FR/ES) versions of the marketing lines and whether those translations are certified or vendor-translated.

We need a response by COB Tue (14 Sep) to keep the planned publish window. If you prefer a quick call to run through the options, propose a 15-min slot.

Attachments: aws_listing_review_ask.docx

Thanks,
Marie Lefevre
Marketplace Ops — AWS Partner Network
marie.lefevre@aws-partner.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Clarify EU listing footnote for 24x7 support & localized branding

Marie — thanks for the clear summary and the doc. Looping in Ben and Karthik who own marketplace copy and regional support routing respectively.

Quick answers up front:
- We cannot assert an unconditional "24x7" SLA for EU customers unless we explicitly state scope and routing exceptions. Proposed footnote (draft):
  "Support availability varies by customer region and offering tier. Critical incident response for EU customers is available 24x7 for Premium subscribers; standard-tier response hours are 8:00–18:00 local business days. See support-window matrix for details."

  That language lets us keep the marketing headline ("24x7 premium support") while tying it to tiered offerings and an explicit link. If AWS requires even more granular routing text (e.g., where data centers are located), we can add a second clause referencing data residency.

- For localized strings: Redwood will own the canonical English copy; Acme has engaged a regional vendor for certified translations. We will validate translations against trademark guidance (we avoid changing punctuation around product names). Ben, can you confirm when we can share the DE/FR/ES assets?

I've attached our brand guidelines and the current support-window matrix for transparency. If AWS needs a signed attestation confirming translations are vendor-certified, we'll get that executed.

Attachments: redwood_brand_guidelines_v3.pdf; support-window-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Clarify EU listing footnote for 24x7 support & localized branding

Kim — +1 on the proposed footnote. A couple of operational clarifications:
- We'll publish the footnote as you suggested and include a link to the support-window matrix page in the listing. For AWS copy we should keep the footnote under 140 chars if possible; I'll draft a concise version.
- Translation status: Acme's vendor confirmed delivery of DE/FR/ES drafts this week. Benchtop check: ensure we do not add localized trademark suffixes (e.g., in DE some product names pick up different article usage). I can sanitize if needed.

Proposed short footnote for AWS UI (<=140 chars):
"Support availability varies by region and tier — see listing for hours and routing exceptions."

If AWS needs the data-residency clause, add after a semicolon: "Data residency and routing vary by region."

Marie — if you and ops accept that short copy, we can provide the translated short-lines for the localized marketplace tiles tomorrow.

—Ben

Two quick asks before we close the preflight: 1) please upload the translated short-lines for DE/FR/ES into the Drive link you shared (or paste them in the email), and 2) provide a one-paragraph attestation (signed by Acme) that translations are vendor-certified and do not modify trademarked product names.

We can accept the concise footnote Ben proposed. We'll publish once we receive the translations and the attestation file (pdf preferred). Planned publish window: Wed 16 Sep if materials arrive by EOD Tue 15 Sep.
